description: Solve PerimeterX/HUMAN behavioural 'Press & Hold' challenges (opt-in) via humanized CDP Input events (Gaussian-randomized ~3-7s hold with +/-1-2px micro-jitter). Auto-locates #px-captcha unless selector is specified. Returns JSON with solved status, hold_ms, and attempts. Use when browser_friction reports perimeterx.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector for hold target (auto-locates #px-captcha if omitted)

name: browser_press_hold
